findings.claim: docs/domain/execution/run.md:36: "(a session or gate that moved refs, a key of `.git/config` outside `run.git-config-ignore` and the built-in editor keys, or the git hooks halts the run, exit 9)"
findings.observed: The run page's table row 9 and the S-2/session/concepts/configuration pages now say a Copilot session that got past its fence also halts with exit 9. This sentence on the same page lists the causes of exit 9 without FENCE BYPASSED or HOOK CHANGED. docs/guide/concepts.md:22 and docs/domain/execution/plan.md:69 do the same for the driver boundary and for acceptance halts, and plan sessions can now halt with FENCE BYPASSED plan. The brief's F4 list does not name these three places.
findings.where: brief F4 (list of places that define exit 9); docs/domain/execution/run.md:36, docs/guide/concepts.md:22, docs/domain/execution/plan.md:69

not_run.line: vloop run --help and vloop brief review --help (reading the exit-code help of the built binary)
not_run.reason: the command was denied by the verify fence; the help text was read in internal/cli/run.go:46 and internal/cli/brief_review.go instead

notes: Worked example: the 8 test lines are the named tests, which I ran (TestRunFenceBackstopBypassed, DeniedByHook, AllowedCall, TestBackstopHookChanged, TestBackstopTimedOutSession, TestCopilotHooksTimeoutSec, TestRunFenceBackstopEveryPhase with 6 subtests). All pass. The Bypassed test asserts only the prefix 'vloop: bash git commit -m x — ' on stderr; the full reason text 'git commit -m x is denied by the work fence (Bash(git commit:*))' matches what 'vloop fence check --phase work --tool bash "git commit -m x"' prints, and 'git push' prints the plan fence line for the plan phase. Not checked: seven-phase tests were run as a group, not read one by one for 'no plan commit' / 'brief restored' assertions. The doc insertions (S-2, session, concepts, configuration, fence-audit x6, B22.3, operate, run.go and brief_review.go help) were read in the diff and match F4's text. In the code, backstop runs after restoreInputs and before gitChanged/REFS MOVED in work, review and verify; in plan and gate-review it runs before the guard check; in review-brief it runs after the brief restore. The hook binary's hash is checked only when Runner.Judge is set; a binary unreadable before the session counts as changed.
